name: Shiina Yui
source: Class rep for AK3:1CE. Seems like a nice, meek girl who wants the best for everyone, but is actually quite manipulative (without realizing it herself). The class rep for Haunted Hoax really likes her, but she doesn’t seem to notice at all.
